name_vi: Khay phục vụ hình quả thận
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A kidney-shaped shallow serving tray with a continuous rounded rim and no handles. Side: Its curved edge rises evenly above a flat bamboo base. Rear: The concave rear edge exposes reinforced rim lashings and underside bamboo ribs. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A kidney-shaped shallow serving tray with a continuous rounded rim and no handles. Side: Its curved edge rises evenly above a flat bamboo base. Rear: The concave rear edge exposes reinforced rim lashings and underside bamboo ribs. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
